style_deviations: sill plant Kenney Furniture Kit plantSmall1 (CC0)

parts.Stream: coffee column spout -> mug (hidden by default)
parts.Splash: coffee drop crown at the mug top
parts.Lever: grind lever, rotate about +X (0 up, ~+40 pulled)
parts.HopperLid: rotate about +X at the back edge

parts.Phone: the phone plopped in, top sticking out (hidden by default)
parts.Splats/Splat0..3: coffee drops on the worktop around the mug (hidden by default)

phone.pivot: phone centre, lying flat in landscape (long axis local X; screen up = -Z, so MOM reads from Bernard with its baseline toward the counter front)

parts.Screen: quad 0.152 x 0.070, UV 0..1 (u along X, v toward -Z): portrait + heart above, MOM; swap its material for a SubViewport texture if wanted. Hidden = off

toaster.slots: two slots along X at local z -0.035 / +0.035 (toast / toast_2)

toast.pivot: slice centre; faces along +-Z (stands in a slot)

parts.Crumbs: crumb burst for the splat on the roommate (hidden by default; place at the hit point)

parts.FragileFront/Back: FRAGILE tape (white caps + glass icons) on both long sides

front_door.rotate: Leaf about +Y: 0 shut, negative opens into the hall (greybox -1.6 works); node rotation 0
